title: Noise-resilient nonadiabatic geometric quantum computation for bosonic binomial codes
summary: The binomial code is renowned for its parity-mediated loss immunity and loss-error recoverability, while geometric phases are widely recognized for their intrinsic resilience against noise. Capitalizing on their complementary merits, we propose a noise-resilient protocol to realize Nonadiabatic geometric quantum computation with binomial codes in a superconducting system composed of a microwave cavity %off-resonantly dispersively coupled to a %three-level qutrit.
